rationale: The plan addresses the finance objective by grouping claims by specialty to compare volume, spend totals, averages, and denial rates, with small-group flagging (threshold: 30 claims) to highlight low-volume specialties. Provider ranking identifies the top 10 rendering providers by highest paid spend, excluding low-volume providers. Report generation includes appropriate caveats for synthetic data and descriptive analysis, with denominators shown for rate interpretation and source citations for reproducibility.
